headline: Counter-terror police recover petrol from vans near RAF Fairford
deck: Searches of three vans discovered near the airfield at the weekend found a quantity of petrol and no explosive devices. Police called the petrol an accelerant.
body: Counter-terror police said a quantity of petrol but no explosive devices were found during searches of three vans discovered near RAF Fairford in the west of England at the weekend [E1][E2].
Police called the petrol an accelerant they had recovered as part of the investigation [E3].
